payload.summary: The incident involves a brute force attack on the account jdoe, but the successful login occurred after a documented change involving the movement of the VPN egress to 10.80.0.15 and a password reset. This suggests that the successful login may be a result of the password reset rather than an attack.

attack_chain.description: The brute force attack on the account jdoe was detected, indicating an attempt to gain unauthorized access.

risk_factors: Successful login after a documented change
